essence: The mantra in question is the Tryambaka mantra beginning with 'tryambakaṃ yajāmaha'.
The mantra is like the sun, present yet imperceptible to those who cannot see.
Śaṅkara's teaching emphatically affirms this doctrine as absolutely true.
The offering is directed to the Great Goddess.
The Lord is asked to explain specifically if he has compassion toward the speaker.
